user_requirements: REQ-1: Lexer and Pratt parser supporting arithmetic, booleans, variables, conditionals, and function calls with exact line/column diagnostics.
REQ-2: Static type checker catching undefined symbols, arity mismatches, and incompatible operand types before evaluation.
REQ-3: Bytecode compiler and stack VM evaluator with deterministic execution and recursion depth protection.
REQ-4: Cross-platform CLI (macOS + Windows UTF-8 file & stdin support) plus comprehensive unit/integration test suite.
architecture_contract: Package root `expr_engine/`. Shared AST, token types, source spans, and diagnostic classes live exclusively in `expr_engine/contracts.py`. All file I/O must use `pathlib.Path` with explicit `encoding='utf-8'`. No module outside `cli.py` may read `sys.argv` or print directly to stdout.
global_acceptance_criteria: AC-1: All unit and integration tests pass with exit code 0.
AC-2: Zero TODO/FIXME/NotImplementedError placeholders across the codebase.
AC-3: Full macOS and Windows compatibility (pathlib paths, UTF-8 I/O, no OS-specific shell invocations).

tasks.title: Create AST, Token, Type, Bytecode OpCode & Diagnostic Contracts
tasks.instructions: Define immutable dataclasses/enums for SourceSpan, Token, TokenKind, Expr AST nodes, ValueType, OpCode, Instruction, and DiagnosticError in `expr_engine/contracts.py`, and export public symbols in `expr_engine/__init__.py`.
tasks.acceptance_check: Verify module imports cleanly without syntax or circular import errors.

tasks.title: Create Cross-Platform Test Fixtures & Project Config
tasks.instructions: Create minimal pytest configuration in `pyproject.toml` and reusable sample expression cases (valid programs + type/syntax error cases) in `tests/conftest.py`.
tasks.acceptance_check: Verify `pyproject.toml` and `tests/conftest.py` are valid UTF-8 and syntactically clean.

initial_waves.wave_name: Wave 2 - Massive Parallel Core & Peripheral Implementation

tasks.title: Implement Lexer & Pratt Parser
tasks.instructions: Implement `tokenize(source: str) -> list[Token]` and `parse(tokens: list[Token]) -> Expr` adhering strictly to `expr_engine/contracts.py` with accurate line/col spans.
tasks.acceptance_check: Check syntax and verify all AST node constructors match `contracts.py`.

tasks.title: Implement Static Type Checker
tasks.instructions: Implement `typecheck(expr: Expr, env: dict[str, ValueType]) -> ValueType` raising `DiagnosticError` on undefined variables, wrong function arity, or type mismatches.
tasks.acceptance_check: Verify all AST variants in `contracts.py` are handled exhaustively.

tasks.title: Implement Bytecode Compiler & Stack VM
tasks.instructions: Compile `Expr` to `list[Instruction]` and execute deterministically in `StackVM` with configurable max call/stack depth guard.
tasks.acceptance_check: Verify every `OpCode` in `contracts.py` is emitted and executed consistently.

tasks.title: Implement Cross-Platform CLI & Public Facade
tasks.instructions: Build `cli.py` using `argparse` and `pathlib.Path(..., encoding='utf-8')` supporting `--eval` and file execution on both macOS and Windows, plus concise usage docs in `README.md`.
tasks.acceptance_check: Ensure no hardcoded OS paths or platform-specific shell assumptions exist.

tasks.title: Implement End-to-End Unit & Integration Test Suite
tasks.instructions: Write thorough tests covering precedence, associativity, conditionals, functions, error diagnostics, VM recursion limits, and UTF-8 CLI file execution.
tasks.acceptance_check: Ensure imports match module APIs and edge cases are asserted.
